verified_facts.text: Amanoi has a Beach Club restaurant where a barbecue dinner of seafood and grilled dishes is served on the sand every Saturday evening.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join us every Saturday at the Beach Club restaurant for a barbecue dinner with the ocean as a spectacular backdrop. The evening features a thoughtfully prepared selection of seafood and grilled dishes, shared in a relaxed yet refined setting on the sand.

verified_facts.text: Guests can take a private hands-on Vietnamese cooking class at the Rock Studio, surrounded by giant granite boulders.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the flavours of Vietnam in a private hands-on cooking class at the Rock Studio, enveloped by giant granite boulders.

verified_facts.text: A Sacred Cham dining experience takes guests to a nearby hidden spot for local delicacies and ends with a blessing ceremony by a Cham master in the jungle.
verified_facts.excerpt: Journey to a nearby hidden spot for an authentic Cham dining experience. Indulge in a feast of local delicacies while surrounded by nature. Conclude the unforgettable evening with a rare blessing ceremony by a respected Cham master in the mystical jungle.

verified_facts.text: Guests can have an intimate, family-style Vietnamese dinner at the home of Ba Hai in Thai An village, ten minutes from Amanoi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dine at the local home of Ba Hai in Thai An village, a charming coastal setting just ten minutes from Amanoi.

verified_facts.text: The Lost Kingdom of Cham journey includes a guided tour of the Cham Museum and a visit to the 13th-century Po Klong Garai Cham Towers.
verified_facts.excerpt: The journey begins with a guided tour of the Cham Museum and continues at the 13th-century Po Klong Garai Cham Towers

verified_facts.text: Guests can join a local artisan for a Cham pottery workshop, a craft still practiced in the nearby village of Bau Truc.
verified_facts.excerpt: Try your hand at Cham pottery, a centuries-old craft still practiced in the nearby village of Bau Truc
